win.message: You escape with the golden treasure in hand. A glorious victory!
You slip away with nothing but a silver ring, but you're alive. A modest ending.
Standing among the roses with the emerald in your palm, you decide this was worth more than any idol. A quiet victory.

treasure.name: golden treasure
treasure.description: A heavy golden idol. This is what you came for.

torch.name: torch
torch.description: An unlit torch, still usable as a light source.

statue.name: stone statue
statue.description: A weathered statue of a forgotten king. Too heavy to move.

silver_ring.name: silver ring
silver_ring.description: A tarnished silver ring, said to bring luck.

iron_key.name: iron key
iron_key.description: A heavy iron key, cold to the touch.

rusty_key.name: rusty key
rusty_key.description: An old rusty key. It might still turn a lock, if you're lucky.

gem.name: emerald
gem.description: A flawless emerald, glinting even in the dark.

note.name: scrap of paper
note.description: A scrawled note: 'Whatever guards the cellar, it doesn't like the dark.'

keeper.name: old keeper
keeper.dialogue: I've guarded this hall for years. Bring me the torch and I'll reward you.
keeper.traded_dialogue: Thank you for the torch. Take care of that ring.

cat.name: black cat
cat.dialogue: The cat eyes you and says nothing.

rat.name: cellar rat
rat.dialogue: A rat scurries between the shelves, indifferent to you.

hall.name: Grand Hall
hall.description: A dusty entrance hall. Cobwebs hang from a cracked ceiling.

library.name: Library
library.description: Rows of rotted bookshelves line the walls.

vault.name: Vault
vault.description: A small stone vault, heavy with the smell of old gold.

outside.name: Outside
outside.description: Sunlight. Fresh air. Freedom, if you're carrying what you came for.

study.name: Study
study.description: A cramped study, its desk buried under yellowed papers.

cellar.name: Cellar
cellar.description: A cold, cramped cellar. Something rustles in the dark.

garden.name: Garden
garden.description: An overgrown garden behind the manor, roses gone wild among the weeds.
